question: On 100,000,000 bytes of the prize corpus, does the cycle 2 method give a smaller archive and a smaller complete size than the strongest compressors already inside the Node runtime?
hypothesis: (a) mixmatch archive bytes are smaller than both the brotli and the zstd archive bytes on enwik8.
(b) mixmatch total_declared_bytes is smaller than both the brotli and the zstd totals on enwik8.
prediction_not_part_of_the_hypothesis: The mixmatch archive lands between 21,000,000 and 25,000,000 bytes. Published figures for scale, not run here: gzip -9 gives 36,445,248; lpaq1, the design this follows without its nibble hashing or secondary estimation, about 19.8 million; the leading prize programs about 15 million.
defeated_if: (a) or (b) fails against either baseline, or any variant fails exact recovery.

baseline.note: scripts/prize-baseline-worker.mjs: brotli quality 11 with a 16 MiB window, zstd level 19; deflate level 9 is carried for scale

candidate.feature_disabled_variant: mix (mix-large): the same program with the repeated-string input switched off

evaluator: src/core/school-prize.ts gradePrizeBundle and comparePrizeBundles, unchanged from c415ef861fc6066a3e741eaf0009992d6332d7bd, proxy track with a 100,000,000-byte inspection limit
cost_definition: shared-program form: 2 * program bytes + archive bytes + option file bytes. The Node runtime is not counted for any variant (program_format unqualified-source).
exposure: enwik8 was downloaded and checksummed before this plan was frozen and was not run through any program here. The large modes (100,000,000-byte limit, 2^26 slots per context table, 2^24 match slots) were chosen and then run once, for timing and exact recovery, on 5,071,786 bytes of this repository's source outside the earlier study inputs: mix+match-large 898,960 bytes, brotli 1,026,586, zstd 1,048,470, deflate 1,406,105. No parameter was changed after that run. The model itself is the cycle 2 model, frozen in df6c951.
negative_controls: one flipped bit in the middle of the mix and mixmatch archives must not yield the original
not_established_here: this is enwik8, a 10% prefix of the prize file enwik9, and no enwik9 figure follows from it
the program is unqualified source on the Node runtime; time, memory and isolation are not held to the prize rules

inputs.name: enwik8
inputs.source: https://mattmahoney.net/dc/enwik8.zip (36,445,475 bytes), MD5 and SHA-1 equal to those published at https://mattmahoney.net/dc/textdata.html
inputs.role: first 10^8 bytes of the English Wikipedia dump of 2006-03-03
